description: Compact list of a block's items for EmailItemEditingMode.Dialog: one row per item with a preview and the move up / move down / edit / remove actions. Edit opens the modal editor over a copy of the item, so the document changes only on Save and always as a single change (one undo step).

parameters.name: Block
parameters.description: The block whose items are listed: social, navbar, carousel or accordion.

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: Raised once after a save, a remove, a move or an add — one editor undo step each.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the list read-only: the dialog's Save is disabled and every mutating action returns early.

parameters.name: OnImageUpload
parameters.description: Optional host upload handler, offered by the carousel image dialog.

parameters.name: ImageUpload
parameters.description: Client-side limits applied to a picked carousel image before OnImageUpload runs; null uses the ImageUploadOptions defaults.
